title: What is incorrect tool argument generation?
summary: It happens when an AI agent selects the correct tool but sends incorrect, incomplete or invalid arguments. The tool itself may be perfectly implemented. The failure is in the parameters generated by the model.
objectives: Explain every point in “What is incorrect tool argument generation?” with clear language
